title: Kairos
tagline: Kairos: Authentically capture & permanently own your memories as NFTs. Your digital legacy, secured.
description:
In an era where digital authenticity is fleeting and personal data sovereignty is lost, Kairos offers a sanctuary. It’s a consumer-first photo diary, redefining how we own our most cherished memories.
Inspired by the daily-capture ritual, Kairos delivers a unique "lazy onboarding" experience: users dive in instantly with just a nickname. The magic truly happens when they choose to "Save Forever." With a simple email login powered by Privy, a secure, non-custodial wallet is seamlessly generated in the background. Each authentic moment – captured within a certain timeframe to ensure its verifiable nature – is then minted as a permanent, timestamped NFT. Your moments are safely secured on decentralized storage.
Kairos is the foundation, focusing on verifiable existence, precise timestamping, and immutable ownership of your digital memories. It proves the core promise: turning fleeting moments into a lasting digital legacy.

The Evolution of Digital Ownership:

Kairos is built for a future where personal memories are truly owned and controlled. Our vision extends to:
Enhanced Privacy: Transforming today's publicly accessible storage into a "sealed box." We plan to implement client-side encryption on the device before upload, ensuring that your most intimate moments remain private and accessible only to you, unless you explicitly choose to share.
Unrivaled Authenticity: Beyond simple timestamps, we envision integrating ZK-proofs for metadata. This will cryptographically verify details like location or adherence to a capture timeframe, without ever revealing sensitive personal data.
Connected Identity: Evolving beyond a basic ENS name, we aim to build a rich, verifiable digital identity. This will enable privacy-preserving social interactions, allowing users to share authentic moments with trusted friends or unlock exclusive benefits from brands based on verified experiences, all within a user-owned economy.
Scalability & Verifiability: Leveraging technologies like Chainlink for advanced verifiable data layers and a modular architecture for seamless multi-chain expansion, ensuring a robust and future-proof platform.
Think of it as POAPs + Onchain BeReal.
how_its_made:
How it's made:

Kairos is built on a modern, modular architecture, designed for scalability and user experience:

Frontend (Next.js 15 + TypeScript): A modern, responsive UI crafted with React and styled using TailwindCSS, optimized for intuitive capture, viewing, and gallery experiences.

Onboarding & Wallet Infrastructure (Privy): Powers the frictionless "lazy onboarding" flow. Privy's embedded wallet SDK securely handles passwordless email logins, non-custodial wallet generation, and seamless transaction signing, completely abstracting Web3 complexity from the user.

Web3 Client (Wagmi & RainbowKit): The project leverages Wagmi for robust blockchain interactions and RainbowKit for standard wallet connections (MetaMask, WalletConnect), ensuring broad compatibility for advanced users.

Blockchain & Smart Contracts (Solidity): The core logic, including NFT minting for permanent memories, is handled by custom smart contracts written in Solidity. The architecture is designed for deployment on a low-cost, high-throughput L2 network (e.g., Base, Optimism, Arbitrum) to ensure fast and affordable minting at scale.
